mythic_source.name: Oenotropae
mythic_source.not: generic superhero power set for Oino

policy.answer: Change how the gift is used. Carry memory home and share it rather than forcing it to repeat forever.
policy.note: Subtle material and relational transformations. Myth lives through choices, recurring images, and sound/material change.

transformation_chain.emotional_read: life made usable as power without claiming dominion over it
heat becomes light-time — hours returned to bodies
atmosphere becomes interface — connection and capture arrive together
digital cold turns toward table warmth without ceremony
vessel waits, then feeds relation — gift used as sharing
grid softens into sister's living contour
archive yields to change instead of endless identical playback
tech line becomes growing line — connection as life, not only extraction

transformation_chain.to: a line of movement through the world
transformation_chain.emotional_read: growth becomes path — pilgrimage, not power display

nourishment_tracks.throughline: Dry bowl / untouched bowls -> shared meal at the table; gift feeds relation.
nourishment_tracks.forced_production_risk: Treat people as endless providers of comfort.

nourishment_tracks.throughline: Clear water -> steam -> haze; stain that only reads as wine under amber.
nourishment_tracks.forced_production_risk: Divert every flow into output; leave nothing to drink.

nourishment_tracks.throughline: Electric relief returns hours — dance possible; empty chair shows uneven return.
nourishment_tracks.forced_production_risk: Schedule every returned hour so nothing is free.

nourishment_tracks.throughline: Assistive synthetic voice for the living; distinct from harvested/reconstructed dead speech.
nourishment_tracks.forced_production_risk: Prefer controllable reconstructed voice over living assisted speech.

nourishment_tracks.throughline: Archive preserves; shadow begins when preservation becomes forced identical replay.
nourishment_tracks.forced_production_risk: Harvest voices; loop the father until he cannot surprise.

nourishment_tracks.throughline: Father's unfinished melody -> sister's altered note; living variation at the end.
nourishment_tracks.forced_production_risk: Quantize the family melody into a too-perfect memorial loop.

forced_production_parallels.oino_echo: Judging blocks/monitors score bodies instead of seeing needs.

forced_production_parallels.image: Oenotropae being treated as a resource
forced_production_parallels.oino_echo: Mythic gift imagined as endless yield — artistic warning, not literal superpower.
Cleaner corridor voices; reconstructed dead speech sold as comfort.

forced_production_parallels.image: Oino repeatedly extracting the same reunion from her father
forced_production_parallels.oino_echo: Shadow: rewind/edit until the encounter cannot surprise her.

resolution.is: changing how the gift is used
resolution.action: Oino carries memory home and shares it rather than forcing it to repeat forever
beats: Preserved image yields to living variation
